hints.title: Interval Scheduling with Weights
hints.text: Each offer covers a closed range of houses [start, end] and yields gold. Overlapping offers cannot both be accepted.

hints.title: End-Position Grouping
hints.text: Group offers by their end house. Define dp[i] as the maximum gold obtainable from houses 0 up to i.

hints.title: Recurrence Relation
hints.text: dp[i] is at least dp[i - 1]. Additionally, for each offer ending at i with range [start, i, gold], compare with (dp[start - 1] if start > 0 else 0) + gold.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan dynamic programming bucketed by offer endpoints.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over all subsets of non-overlapping offers takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + m) memory for the DP table and end-index buckets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Group offers by end index to achieve optimal linear time dynamic programming.
